human_walk_run.phase_rule: preserve normalized phase; start destination at source phase * destination duration
human_walk_run.playback_rate: speed / blended reference speed; clamp 0.65..1.35; blend toward idle below walking threshold
human_walk_run.foot_contact_events: not authored; solve contact and footsteps after engine foot-plant tuning

quadruped_walk_run.phase_rule: preserve hind.L phase; front legs crossfade across gait change; use contact IK when integrated
quadruped_walk_run.blend_rule: per species: normalized speed between walk and run reference speeds; smoothstep weight

turning.reference_pose_kind: shared rest A pose, not additive motion
turning.yaw_policy: Either keep actor fixed during clip then atomically transfer final yaw to actor and clear root yaw, or extract per-frame root yaw delta into actor and remove it from sampled skeleton. Never apply both.
turning.moving_turn: steer actor heading continuously while blending locomotion; retain locomotion root yaw at zero
turning.pose_bridge: when a stationary clip is interrupted, resolve root yaw first, blend remaining pose toward turn_pose over 0.08s, then toward next pose over 0.12s
turning.large_turn: chain 90-degree clips; use actor steering for residual angle

attack.weapon_socket: human hand.R; no weapon asset or weapon-specific attack included
attack.note: Gameplay hitbox timing and damage are external. Hit window is a proposal, not embedded animation events.

physics_driven.start_to_air: start finishes or grounded becomes false
physics_driven.land_to_locomotion: land finishes; restore current desired speed with fresh blend
physics_driven.root_vertical: remove visual root height if physics already drives the body center; optionally retain small landing squash

blend_math.rotations: shortest-path normalized quaternion slerp, per bone in local space
blend_math.translations: linear interpolation, per bone in local space
blend_math.weights: normalize active clip weights to sum 1
blend_math.loop_endpoint: last sample duplicates first for looping clips; wrap by (frames - 1) / fps
blend_math.single_frame_pose: turn_pose contains one sample; clamp sample time to zero
